text:
# filter.transaction

TL;DR:
- filter.transaction filters by whether the current actor has a related transaction.

What it means:
- It narrows results using actor-scoped transaction linkage.

Agent hint:
- Use it when the workflow explicitly cares about whether the current user already has a transaction relation to listings.
